description: Signature Base64 carries excess padding beyond the RFC 4648 requirement: valid 88-char shape ('A' * 86 + '==') suffixed with four additional '=' characters, yielding a 92-character string that is mod-4 clean and uses only the standard alphabet. Under v0.9.0a2 the string passes the length and alphabet pre-checks in _b64decode but is rejected by base64.b64decode(..., validate=True) as 'Excess data after padding' (Phase 2.3).
source: Wire-representation strictness follow-through of MAINT-F2: extra '=' beyond the RFC 4648 requirement must be rejected. The 92-character variant (valid 88-char shape + '====') exercises base64.b64decode(..., validate=True) rejecting 'Excess data after padding' per docs/spec-evidence.md §4.1.2.
